notes: A published workflow with wait:approval@1 returns 202 and status waiting. The approval link is not in that response. A person answers from the link or the Approvals inbox unless the step allows API decisions.
The message is untrusted case text. It is sent as JSON data. This program does not treat it as instructions.
A retry with this same key and body returns the original run and does not start another one. The duplicate response omits the output. https://kovca.io/docs/idempotency
